resources.string: The password manager from the Aman family
Your privacy first: no ads, no data collection, and no account asked of you.
Your vault is a single encrypted file in the open KDBX standard — opened by Hisn on your computer: Windows and Linux.
No internet — except optional local sync between your own devices.
The vault is created as a single encrypted file on this device, in the same KDBX format Hisn opens on your computer: Windows and Linux.
The master password is the only key to your vault; if it is forgotten there is no way to recover it or to open the vault.
The new vault could not be encrypted
The vault file could not be written to this device
The vault was created but could not be opened
Create a new vault on this device, or open a .kdbx file copied from your computer.
The file you choose will take the place of the current vault on this device. The current vault is kept aside in a separate file inside the app\'s storage and is not deleted.
